body.heading: Start slowly
paragraphs: A tongue twister is a sentence that trips your tongue. Try this one very slowly: She sells seashells by the seashore.
Say it three times slowly, then a little faster. Your tongue must dance between sounds that are almost the same.

body.heading: Try more twisters
paragraphs: Here is another: Red lorry, yellow lorry. And a short tricky one: Toy boat, toy boat, toy boat.
Watch your mouth in the mirror. Your lips and tongue move in complicated patterns, faster than you can think about them.

body.heading: Invent your own
paragraphs: Pick a sound you like, such as the letter P. Now write a silly sentence where lots of words start with it: Peter Penguin paints purple pumpkins.
The best twisters are funny as well as tricky. Write yours down and challenge your family at dinner.

takeaway: Tongue twisters train your mouth to move precisely, and the mistakes are the funniest part.
safetyNotes: This is a talking game — take breaks if your mouth gets tired, and laugh as much as you like.
screenFreeExtension: Teach your twister to someone else and count how many tries they need.
